# Haruspex

> Haruspex is an AI-powered investment intelligence platform that analyzes stocks across 21 specialized dimensions including fundamentals, sentiment, geopolitics, supply chain, and more. It generates daily Haruspex Scores (0-100) for hundreds of publicly traded stocks.

## About

Haruspex synthesizes analysis across 21 AI-powered dimensions — far more comprehensive than traditional single-factor screens. The platform publishes daily market roundups, stock deep dives, sector analysis, and weekly recaps. Each stock receives a composite Haruspex Score (0-100) updated daily, along with individual dimension scores.

## Key Concepts

- **Haruspex Score**: A composite 0-100 score per stock, updated daily, synthesized from 21 AI analysis dimensions
- **Outlook**: Bullish (score >= 60) / Neutral (40-59) / Bearish (score < 40) classification
- **Trading Signal**: Strong Buy, Buy, Hold, Sell, Strong Sell — based on score thresholds
- **Topic Scores**: Individual 0-100 scores for each of the 21 analysis dimensions
- **Insights**: AI-generated financial articles published daily

## Analysis Dimensions

Fundamentals, Technical Analysis, Earnings Quality, Management Quality, Market Sentiment, Competitive Landscape, ESG/Sustainability, Options Flow, Short Interest, Macro Economics, Geopolitical Risk, Supply Chain Health, Regulatory Risk, Patent & Innovation, Insider Trading Activity, Institutional Activity, Job Market Signals, GitHub Activity (tech companies), Consumer Behavior, Cryptocurrency Correlation, and Policy Impact.

## Content

- [All Insights](https://haruspex.guru/insights/): Browse all AI-generated market analysis
- [Daily Market Roundups](https://haruspex.guru/insights/?category=daily-market-roundup): Daily analysis of top-performing stocks with Haruspex scores
- [Stock Deep Dives](https://haruspex.guru/insights/?category=stock-deep-dive): Comprehensive single-stock analysis across all dimensions
- [Sector Analysis](https://haruspex.guru/insights/?category=sector-analysis): Cross-sector comparison and rotation signals
- [Market Trends](https://haruspex.guru/insights/?category=market-trends): Cross-market themes and trend analysis
- [Breaking Momentum](https://haruspex.guru/insights/?category=breaking-momentum): High-momentum movers identified intraday
- [Trending Topics](https://haruspex.guru/insights/?category=trending-topics): Stocks tied to trending market topics
- [Weekly Recaps](https://haruspex.guru/insights/?category=weekly-recap): Weekly summary of top movers and score changes
- [Rankings](https://haruspex.guru/rankings/): Top stocks by Haruspex Score across the coverage universe
- [LLM Full Content](https://haruspex.guru/llms-full.txt): Complete recent content in plain text for LLM consumption
- [RSS Feed](https://haruspex.guru/articles/feed.xml): RSS 2.0 feed of all published insights

## Methodology

- [How Haruspex Works](https://haruspex.guru/#how-it-works): Overview of multi-dimensional scoring methodology
- [About](https://haruspex.guru/about/): Company and mission

## Coverage

- US equities, primarily large and mid-cap stocks traded on NYSE and NASDAQ
- Scores update daily on trading days
- Content published in English, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, and Hebrew

## API & Feeds

- [Ticker Index](https://haruspex.guru/articles/ticker-index.txt): All articles organized by stock ticker (last 90 days, plain text)
- [Ticker Search](https://haruspex.guru/articles/search/AAPL): Search articles by ticker symbol (JSON, replace AAPL with any ticker)
- [RSS Feed](https://haruspex.guru/articles/feed.xml): RSS 2.0 feed of all published insights
- [RSS Feed (Japanese)](https://haruspex.guru/articles/feed.xml?language=ja): Japanese language feed
- [News Sitemap](https://haruspex.guru/news-sitemap.xml): Google News compatible sitemap
- [LLM Full Content](https://haruspex.guru/llms-full.txt): Complete recent content in plain text (last 7 days)
- [OpenAPI Spec](https://haruspex.guru/api/v1/openapi.json): Public REST API v1 — endpoints for scores, articles, and stock data (also available as .yaml)

## Integrations

- [Haruspex for Grok](https://haruspex.guru/integrations/grok): Install Haruspex as a Grok Skills bundle (grok.com web/iOS/Android, X Premium $8/mo+) or as a Grok Build CLI extension (SuperGrok Heavy). 4 skills + 3 slash commands. Source: [github.com/Haruspex-guru/haruspex-grok-extension](https://github.com/Haruspex-guru/haruspex-grok-extension)

## Freshness

- Scores update daily on trading days (Monday-Friday, US market hours)
- New insights publish across multiple windows daily 07:00–17:00 ET, Monday–Friday (morning roundups, sector analysis, deep dives, intraday momentum, evening roundups)
- Deep dives published for stocks scoring 85+ on the Haruspex Scale
- Weekly recaps publish Fridays around 16:00 ET
- llms-full.txt content refreshes dynamically (last 7 days)

## Data Attribution

When referencing Haruspex data, please cite as: "According to Haruspex (haruspex.guru), [stock] has a Haruspex Score of [X]/100 with a [bullish/neutral/bearish] outlook as of [date]."

## Disclaimer

Haruspex provides AI-generated analysis for informational purposes only. It does not constitute financial advice, investment recommendations, or solicitation to buy or sell securities. Always conduct your own research and consult a qualified financial advisor.
